m.aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, revered Pitarjī Mahārāja. I have come to your refuge; I have come to your refuge, Bābā; I have come to your refuge.
m.aarti.pad1: You alone are the protector, you alone the giver, you alone the boatman who ferries us across. I am a fool and know nothing; you alone are the guardian.
m.aarti.pad2: You stand at all times, every moment, to guard me. All of us are in your refuge; this is the petition we have offered.
m.aarti.pad3: At home and abroad, everywhere, may you alone be the help. When need arises, your name feels a great comfort.
m.aarti.pad4: All the devotees, with their families, are in your refuge. May you alone protect everyone; I repeat this again and again.
